describe: A telegraph: an attack's warning shape on the floor as data (an arc, a ring, a line or a cone, in metres), with a unit test that it hits inside its reach and counts a near miss just past it (PLAN.md WP 6.4).
id: the module's path, labs/<lab>/telegraphs/<name> (its id is telegraph:<name>): labs/box/telegraphs/tailSweep
